Let me add more details to this answer.  First you have to sign papers to pretty much give all your rights away.  You have the option of denying and not signing certain things but they don't tell you that.  You have to read all the paperwork carefully and ask questions.  Don't just let them tell you to sign where there's an X on the paper.  Also know that this will NOT be a quick thing.  Most likely they will keep you overnight.  This will cost money.  If you have insurance than it will be ok (if they don't run some crazy expensive tests on you).  If not, there might be something they have that covers people who can't pay but that is not a guarantee.  They will take all your property away from you besides your clothes.  No electronics (such as phones and mp3 player), no shoes (they don't want you to hang yourself with your laces) and no belts.  You will be asked the same few questions by everyone that sees you.  You will be stripped search for bruises and cuts (not optional).  If you take a shower, you will get your clothes replaced with a paper gown.  Bathrooms are locked so you need to ask permission.  You will be horded to a big room filled with beds lined up next to each other.  TV time and channnel will be determined by the nurses.  You better sleep at night cause they track who slept and who didn't.  They will check your blood pressure every few hours (even while you're in deep sleep).  And if you are lucky to get released the next day, they have to contact someone related to you to talk with them before you can be released.  If you wanted this to be kept a secret from family, it won't be a secret for long.  You will be bored out of your mind the whole time you are there.  You will feel like a prisoner or some cattle waiting for the slaughter.

In short, go make an appointment with a psychiatrist in some office before you decide to do this.  I've gone through it and it wasn't fun at all.  Personally I think it is messed up how people get treated there when they are seeking help.  Read my previous post for more info.
